summary: Python data conversion package root plus shared support code: CONST_PYTHON_DATAFORMAT enum, dataclass and Pydantic mappers, an XML sanitizer, and collection/enum helpers. The package __init__ exports only PydataIngress; ingress and egress live in sub-packages.
key_classes: CONST_PYTHON_DATAFORMAT — enum of supported Python data formats (DATACLASS, PYDANTIC, PYDICT, PYLIST, NAMEDTUPLE, TUPLE, INDEXED_DATA, SERIES_DICT, COLLECTION, UNKNOWN)
key_functions: map_dict_to_dataclass / map_list_of_dicts_to_dataclasses (mappers/dataclass_mapping.py) — build dataclasses from rows
restore_special_characters / validate_file_xsd (sanitizers/xml_sanitizer.py) — XML sanitising and XSD validation
member_names / find_member / is_enum (utils/enum_helpers.py) — Enum lookup helpers
extension_points: Handlers are added in pydata.ingress / pydata.egress; this scope only supplies shared helpers and constants
lifecycle_notes: Recent changes: 838a285b, 5fe83898 (session-scoped compilation reuse, #405), c1e8da53, 22cc3292, a68147b6.
risks: Package __init__ docstring states the public API 'will be added as modules are stabilized'; the exported surface is minimal and the rest is import-by-path.
Docstring header still names the legacy 'mountainash-pydata' package.
open_questions: Whether mappers, sanitizers and utils are intended as public helpers or internal support is not stated; classified semi-public from tests only.
